create_value_dataset: create a single-column HuggingFace Dataset from a pandas DataFrame with a specified dtype using value()
create_other_dataset: create a single-column HuggingFace Dataset from a dict with an optional FeatureType using other()
get_test_datasets_fixture: get a mapping of named test Datasets covering all HuggingFace feature types using the datasets fixture
test_duckdb_index_dataset: test DuckDB full-text search indexing with the duckdb_index dataset containing text, audio, video, and image columns
test_descriptive_statistics_dataset: test descriptive statistics computation with the descriptive_statistics dataset containing various numeric and string columns
